question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-12) + (-4) × 6
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: (-9) − (-60) ÷ (-12) + (-4) × 6

**Formula Used:**

Follow BODMAS (Bracket, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

**Calculation:**

(-9) - (-60) ÷ (-12) + (-4) × 6 

⇒ (-9) - 5 + (-4) × 6 

⇒ (-9) - 5 + -24

⇒ -14 - 24 = -38

**∴ The value of the expression is -38.**
